definitions.explanation: A counter for counting the duration of time in years. Emphasizes the span or period of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{年間|ねんかん}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいました→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I lived in Japan for three years.

examples.japanese: {年間|ねんかん}⟦{売|う}り{上|あ}げ→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Annual sales are one million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧{年間|ねんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have ten years of experience.

notes: {年間|ねんかん} emphasizes duration over a period of years. It can also mean 'annual' or 'yearly' when used as a prefix. Compare with ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ which is used for counting years more generally (⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{年|ねん} = three years) or for naming years ({2024年|にせんにじゅうよねん} = the year 2024).
